name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 29 - Am 36
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 29c. Calls on the Member States to ensure that tenants and consumers of mortgage services are not bound by unfair contract terms and have access to effective judicial remedies, in accordance with Directive 93/13/EEC1a; calls, in particular, on the Member States to ensure that national courts may examine the possible unfairness of relevant contractual terms on their own initiative and that effective interim measures are available, where necessary, to stay or suspend enforcement and eviction proceedings pending such judicial assessment; \_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Directive 93/13/EEC of 5 April 1993 on unfair terms in consumer contracts (OJ L 95, 21.4.1993, p. 29, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/1993/13/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/1993/13/oj)).
